issue_body:
# Home page performance regression

**Audited:** 2026-11-06T15:56:02.985Z
**Previous score:** 91 | **Current score:** 80 (↓11 pts, below 85 threshold)

## Key metrics

| Metric | Previous | Current | Δ |
|--------|----------|---------|---|
| Performance | 91 | 80 | ↓11 |
| LCP | 3,327 ms | 3,993 ms | +666 ms |
| TBT | 81 ms | 260 ms | +179 ms |
| CLS | 0.015 | 0.015 | — |

## Likely cause

Total Blocking Time nearly tripled (81ms → 260ms), indicating a significant increase in main-thread blocking work on the home page. This could be caused by:
- A newly introduced or un-deferred third-party script
- A heavy animation or canvas initialization running synchronously on load
- A JS bundle that is no longer code-split or deferred

## Recommended actions

1. Run a Lighthouse trace locally and inspect the "Avoid long main-thread tasks" and "Reduce JavaScript execution time" opportunities.
2. Check for any recently added scripts or npm packages that may execute on the home page.
3. Defer or async-load non-critical JS (animations, analytics, chat widgets, etc.) until after the page is interactive.
4. Consider code-splitting the home page bundle if it has grown.

## Context

All other scores (accessibility, best-practices, SEO) remain at 100. Visual layout is intact on both desktop and mobile. The two project detail pages (/projects/note-structurer at 78, /projects/screenshot-to-primevue at 76) continue to sit below the 85 threshold and their TBTs have also increased this run, suggesting a shared JS bundle may be the common root cause.
